newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE TUESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE TUESDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were fully steady, USDA said. Demand and seller interest very good, particularly after noon. Confirmed - 53,600 Last Week - 15,400 Last Year - 1,400 Wk To Date- 66,700 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 20,300 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 5,100

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs - 65.00-66.00, ( weighted average 65.51 ); dressed basis 105.00-105.50, often 105.00, instances 106.00 on predominately Choice, some early or in far West 104.00 ( weighted average 105.04). Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - 65.00-66.00 ( weighted average 65.51 ); dressed basis mostly 105.00, instances 105.50- 106.00 on mostly Choice, some early or in far West 104.00 ( weighted average 105.02 )
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
